openings.claim: Removable lateral stops may resist sliding without compression-associated opposite-corner lift: replace seal-friction downward preload with hatch-edge bearing against supplied-strip stops. Cut/drill only strips; support stops with bolted rubber-padded removable rim clamps and vertical release clearance. Rival: padded friction hold-down.
openings.discriminator: Adequate clamp purchase and stop stiffness should limit displacement without tightening the left corner. Rival: reduced preload restores sliding; increased preload can reproduce opposite-corner lift. Equivalent displacement and lift do not discriminate. Stop slip or opposite-corner lift defeats separating lateral restraint from compression.
openings.probe: First ruler-check accessible rim purchase, bolt reach and marked-position stop layout permitting full hatch removal; park if absent. Fabricate at most two configurations: stops and padded hold-down; stop if both cannot fit ninety minutes. Each receives ten opening cycles: measure closure position, reopening time, and seal tears after each cycle. Pull after cycles one and ten, then one additional closure/pull with the stipulated 1 mm right-contact card per configuration: six total trials. Record displacement and opposite-corner lift before/during each 20 N pull. Require position within 1 mm, 20 N resistance, and one-technician reopening within thirty seconds; disturbed closure waives only seal-contact continuity. Remove/relocate all rim components outside the full marked opening when open; use supplied cord for recoverability. Retain hatch, rim and seal; no drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation of hatch/trough; no powered mechanism; new visible seal tears fail.
openings.uncertainty: Unprovided rim geometry may prevent removable clamps/unobstructed release. Stiff stops from supplied strips, six bolts and pads remain assumed. Verify cord routing and twenty-minute observation feasibility for cycles/measurements; unknown resources permit no constraint relaxation.

lineage.reason: Causal relation, full rival/defeat test, feasibility gates, stopping/resource caveats, uncertainty and declared uncertain fit retained.

decision: One speculative opening; dimensional inspection gates resources, not performance. Cycle/pull comparison remains a probe, not deployment or demonstrated success.
